text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Tosen Jordan still believes that my talents as a trainer are better suited to a trainee smarter than her.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: But she also knows that she's the only one who can achieve the goal I've set for her—to become the greatest dummy.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The autumn Tenno Sho will see a field of runners who could all be called the greatest, but she'll run faster than any of them—no, faster than anyone ever.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She declares both to her friends and the media that she's going to make it big… as the greatest dummy ever!
